name: Quarter War
description: Be it a city, open plain, river, or ancient ruin, few places in Calad remain untouched by conflict. Small-scale skirmishes for control of territory are a common occurrence between rival factions, cults, and even neighboring lords.

setup.label: Corner Deployment
setup.description: Players deploy in opposing corners. Each Deployment Zone extends 9" from its corner.

questRules.label: Stronger Presence
questRules.description: Stronger Presence is determined by calculating the total Recruitment Points of each party fully within the specified Quarter. Add together the Recruitment Points of all Alive Party Members fully within that Quarter (do not include Upgrades). Compare this total with the other player(s). The player with the highest Recruitment Point total has the Stronger Presence.
